description.zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 密钥对所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the key pair. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the latest region list.

description.zh: SSH密钥对所在的企业资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the SSH key pair belongs.

description.zh: 密钥对的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The key of tag N of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 密钥对的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The value of tag N of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:. The tag value cannot contain http:// or https://.

descriptions.zh:
除了调用CreateKeyPair创建密钥对之外，您还可以使用第三方工具创建密钥对，然后上传（[ImportKeyPair](~~51774~~)）到某一阿里云地域，其使用方法和系统为您创建的密钥对是一致的。

您在每个地域的密钥对数最高为500对。更多信息，请参见[使用限制](~~25412~~)。
descriptions.en:
In addition to calling CreateKeyPair to create a key pair, you can use a third-party tool to create a key pair and then upload it ([ImportKeyPair](~~51774~~)) to a region. The usage of a key pair created by a third-party tool is the same as that of a key pair created by the system.

You can have up to 500 key pairs in each region. For more information, see [Limits](~~25412~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --biz-key-pair-name testKeyPairName --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs CreateKeyPair --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairName testKeyPairName --Tag.1.Key TestKey --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
